title: THE WAGES OF A SURRENDERED CHILD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Pharaoh's daughter said to her, "Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you." So the woman took the baby and nursed him." - Exodus 2:9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Read that again slowly. The mother who risked her life to hide this baby is now being paid to raise him. She had let go of him completely. God gave him back — and provided for her while she did it.

Be careful here. This is not a promise that everything we surrender will be returned to us in this life. Scripture is honest that many faithful people surrender things they never receive back. Prosperity teaching twists moments like this into a formula, and we must not.

But what this moment does show us is the generosity of God's character. He is never in debt to anyone. He is never stingy with those who trust Him.

And practically, these were the years that shaped Moses. During this nursing time, his own mother taught him who he was and whose people he belonged to. That teaching held — decades later, raised in a palace, he still knew he was a Hebrew.

Never underestimate what a parent pours into a child in the early years. It may be the most important work you ever do.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What have I surrendered to God that I am still grieving?
2. What am I teaching the children in my life while I still have their attention?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Generous Father, thank You that nothing given to You is ever lost. Help me to pour truth into the young lives You have placed near me. Amen.
